Population increased in Waltham Forest

The estimated population of Waltham Forest in 2024 was 279,737 usual residents, a rise of 0.4% since 2023.

This meant that Waltham Forest's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Waltham Forest increased by 0.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Waltham Forest was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Waltham Forest

The average (median) age rose to 36.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Waltham Forest has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Waltham Forest is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Waltham Forest's population of 279,737 usual residents was made up of:

  • 56,077 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20%)
  • 193,593 people aged 16 to 64 years, (69.2%)
  • 30,067 people aged 65 years and over, (10.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Waltham Forest has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (10.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Waltham Forest, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Waltham Forest
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Waltham Forest, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,505 people (0.9%). In total, there were 3,993 births and 1,488 deaths in Waltham Forest.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,919 (-1.4%). There were 23,573 people entering the area and 27,492 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Waltham Forest's population of 2,642 (0.9%) as a result of 6,207 people entering the area and 3,565 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Waltham Forest was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Waltham Forest in mid-2023 is 278,506.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,166 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 360 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,526 people.
